title: ToraOS: Four Research Papers and the Universal Semantic Constitution (Rev006)
description: ToraOS is a proposal for a subject-centric AI operating architecture. Each subject — a person, a company, or a community — keeps its own context, decisions, and authority, connects to others only through explicit directional relations, and grows its judgment from real-world outcomes, so that the grounds and history of its decisions remain with the subject even as AI models and applications change. This collection contains four research papers and the ToraOS Universal Semantic Constitution: P0, the main architecture proposal (2026-08-29); P1, a concept note on subject ontology (2026-08-30); P2, on complementing LLM semantic maps with directional relations (2026-09-19); P3, on the mutual perspectives of multiple personal and community subjects (2026-09-28); and the Universal Semantic Constitution, Rev006. All papers are proposals and research drafts and have not been peer reviewed. Japanese originals are authoritative; English versions are translation drafts. The Japanese P2 is a public version in which only two links to private materials are masked. The ideas are the author's; the paper texts were written with GPT, and AI assistance was also used for translation and preparation.
